contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ CONSTANTINVS PF AVG ; R/ [GLORIA EXERCITVS]

Copper alloy Coin. Nummus of Constantine I (306-337), Gloria Exercitus issue of 330-335, Reece period 17, Trier mint. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTANTINVS PF AVG. Reverse description: Two soldiers with two standards between them. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA EXERCITVS]. In exergue: symbol (dot in U) PT[R]. Cliff Reeves kindly identified this coin. Diameter: 16.2mm, Weight: 2.31gms, die axis: 12
